newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX firms 4.55 pts on year-end block trades.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX firms 4.55 pts on year-end block trades.

text.p: Leading Slovak shares closed higher in heavy block trading on the Bratislava Stock exchange on Thursday, the last trading day of 1996.
The 12-share SAX index closed 4.55 points higher at 178.05 on block trading done mostly to realign portfolios for accounting purposes, brokers said.
"There were some big jumps, but they meant very little as they did not reflect the real value of issues," said trader Libor Briska of Creditanstalt.
"For example oil refiner Slovnaft went in blocks priced at 780 crowns, while its real value is around 640," he added.
Slovnaft finally closed 19 crowns lower at 780, while the biggest winner of the day, VUB bank gained 250 crowns to close at 1,900 crowns.
Oil storage Nafta also rebounded 99 crowns to close the year at 1,599, well below its long-term performance of around 2,400 crowns before its sell-off by the National Property Fund last summer.
Overall volume of shares traded was up to 4,149,963 from Wednesday's 3,135,881, and turnover rose to 9.47 billion crowns from 1.73 billion crowns.
Trading on the bourse resumes on January 7.
